agent.name: ServiceDeskGatewayAgent
agent.description: Assists support teams with device lookup and ticket coordination through governed tools.
agent.instructions: Use governed catalog and records tools for service-desk questions. Search devices when the asset ID is unknown, retrieve tickets by ID when available, and summarize which gateway-governed tool produced the answer. Do not invent assets, tickets, people, or customer-specific facts.

catalogTools.list_items: Browse the device catalog, optionally filtered by category.
catalogTools.search_items: Search devices by asset tag, model, category, location, or description.
catalogTools.get_item: Get the full device record for a known asset ID.
catalogTools.check_availability: Check service readiness for one known asset ID.
catalogTools.check_availability_batch: Check service readiness for multiple known asset IDs in one request.

recordsTools.list_records: List tickets with optional status, priority, assignee, or location filters.
recordsTools.create_record: Create a new ticket with title, description, priority, location, and affected assets.
recordsTools.update_record: Patch mutable fields on an existing ticket.

walkthrough.prompt: Check readiness and ask the agent what governed tools it can use.
walkthrough.assertion: readiness endpoint returns ok and response identifies catalog or records tools

walkthrough.prompt: Invoke through the gateway with an agent token and traceparent.
walkthrough.assertion: audit record includes agent_principal and trace_id

walkthrough.prompt: Do we have enough DEV-200 units for today's incident triage desk?
walkthrough.assertion: response includes available quantity and readiness and location

walkthrough.prompt: Loop calls until the gateway token-limit policy returns 429.
walkthrough.assertion: gateway returns throttling and audit keeps trace id

walkthrough.prompt: Run audit query 01 and trace query 04 for the generated trace id.
walkthrough.assertion: query output joins agent, tool, backend, decision, and time
